card.name: Drug names in interaction sections
card.fires_on: Partway through or right after a drug name (cyclosporine, warfarin, digoxin, ivosidenib) or a drug-group noun in drug-interaction text. The next words are usually about adjusting dose or a changed effect.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of drug names heading interaction entries.
modes.example: 7.4 Warfar<<in>> Solifenacin has no significant effect on

modes.label: Drug-group nouns
modes.description: Words like drugs or which naming the affected medicines, just before a verb of effect.
modes.example: High-dose treatment of methotrexate and these other<< drugs>> may result in elevated serum levels of f

modes.label: Other subject nouns
modes.description: Occasional non-drug nouns in general web text before a verb.
modes.example: many owners and their<< families>> would host Christmas parties.

card.writes: Pushes toward verbs of need or dependence such as requiring, needs and rely.
card.plain: It lights up on drug names in interaction sections, where the next words say what the drug needs or how it is affected.
